rationale: Workload Mode coordination, Hardware Safety enforcement, resource admission, placement, reservation and lease ownership are deterministic fail-closed control-plane functions. Under FA3 the Host Resource Broker remains the exclusive physical resource authority; Decision Fabric must not select modes, resources, providers or models, expand candidates, or authorize host mutation.

project_radar_review.scope: FA3 Workload Mode Framework against the Decision Fabric boundary
project_radar_review.note: Deterministic policy, explicit user intent, Workload Mode coordination and HRB authority remain authoritative; no scoring or advisory decision point is delegated.
